input.quote: 13.2 Termination by Ono without Cause. Commencing on the later of (i) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Binimetinib Product in the Ono Territory, or (ii) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Encorafenib Product in the Ono Territory, Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement, for any reasons by giving [ * ] advance written notice to Array which shall be accompanied by the rationale for such termination.
input.rationale: Section 13.1 creates a long multi-year term running through the Secondary Royalty Term, and Section 13.2 gives Ono an at-will exit only after the later of the redacted anniversaries of First Commercial Sale of both the Binimetinib and Encorafenib Products. Ono therefore has no convenience right during development, launch and the early commercial period — effectively no customer convenience right for the majority of a multi-year term, which is walk-away territory under this rule; the notice period is also redacted and cannot be confirmed against the 30-day preferred or 60-90 day fallback range. We have proposed the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position: the at-will right is available at any time on thirty (30) days' notice with a refund of amounts prepaid for post-termination periods, and we flag the 60-90 day fallback as a fallback if Array needs transition runway. Positive for us and not flagged: Array has no termination-for-convenience right at all (its only unilateral rights are for breach, insolvency and Ono's Competing Product activity). Noted but not separately flagged here: the post-termination Competing Product restriction in Section 8.2 (p0492) and Ono's transition-cost responsibility in Article XIV operate as soft costs of an at-will exit.

ops.oldText: Commencing on the later of (i) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Binimetinib Product in the Ono Territory, or (ii) [ * ] of the First Commercial Sale of the Encorafenib Product in the Ono Territory, Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement, for any reasons by giving [ * ] advance written notice to Array
ops.newText: Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement at any time during the Term, in whole or on a Product-by-Product or country-by-country basis, for any reason by giving thirty (30) days' advance written notice to Array, in which case Array shall refund to Ono any amounts prepaid by Ono in respect of the period after the effective date of such termination

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made Ono's at-will termination right available throughout the Term on thirty (30) days' notice, with a refund of amounts prepaid for periods after termination, rather than deferring it until years after First Commercial Sale of both Products. Our playbook requires a customer convenience exit in any multi-year term; we can discuss a longer notice period of 60-90 days if Array needs more transition runway.
proposal.summary: Ono may terminate at will at any time on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepayments.
